# E0301: the lineage lacks a lens its versions require

A lineage declares a lens from every schema back to its predecessor, and one
forward across every major version, so that an instance of any version can be
translated to any other. This lineage adds version 0.1 without the lens back to
0.0.

## Example

`lineage.cue`:

```cue
name: "ship"
schemas: {
	"0": {
		"0": {
			schema: {
				a: string
			}
		}
		"1": {
			schema: {
				a: string
				b?: int
			}
		}
	}
}
```

thema reports:

```
error[E0301]: the lineage has no lens 0.1->0.0
 --> lineage.cue:1:1
  |
1 | name: "ship"
  | ^^^^
  |
  = note: every schema needs a lens back to its predecessor, so that instances of 0.1 can be translated to 0.0
```
